summary: Tested large Aftersales document uploads, backend and frontend, through the public preview URL with synthetic TEST_ data. No live emails were sent and nothing was written to Sage or Sicon. WORKING: (1) Root cause reproduced: the legacy direct upload of a 2.8 MB PDF still returns 413. (2) Chunked upload works: a partial upload resumes (status lists the missing chunks, an early complete returns 400 'Missing chunks', the rest then completes), a repeated complete returns the same file id with one db.files row, and a wrong sha256 fails with the integrity error. (3) Background import of a 2.8 MB, 20-page PDF (400 lines plus noise images) returns 400/400 lines, and coverage reports 20 pages and 5/5 parts. Re-importing the same file returns existing:true with no duplicate import. (4) Isolation: another org's file_id gives 404 on from-file and on extract-pricing-jobs, another org's job id gives 404, and a user without quotes.maintenance gets 403. (5) UI as cm.coordinator: the dropzone, progress bar and 4 stage chips work, and no 413 was seen. Under a throttled network, Cancel shows 'Upload cancelled.' with Resume and Retry, and Resume completes the upload. The results table shows the coverage note, paging of 50 lines ('Lines 1-50 of 400', Next and Previous), search by serial (1 row), the status filter with counts, and the status column. Re-upload shows the toast 'This document was already imported - showing the saved result'. The flow then went: pick customer, pick site, 'Use in Build Quote' (240 machines), Build Quote From Estate (100% priced), Save. Quote AFS-2026-6BAF0 was created and 240 machines were added with status pending_installation. (6) Custom tender, quick mode: a 4.1 MB xlsx with 3 sheets and embedded images gave 120/120 service, 60/60 travel and 30/30 repair rows, and coverage reads 'Whole document read - 3 worksheet(s), 213 row(s)'. (7) Renewal gate (API): approve-send sets renewal_comms_status and renewal_email_state to awaiting_dispatch with email_delivered false. Resend returns 409 'switched off'. cancel-email returns 403 for the coordinator, 422 with no reason, and 200 for the admin with a reason (state becomes cancelled). (8) Maintenance Master PATCH: changing start_date, end_date, annual_value, payment_frequency, direct_debit, visits_per_year or sicon_contract_id with a short or missing reason returns 422. Changing only comments is allowed with no reason. Revision goes 1->2->3 and crm2_contract_changes records each field with its reason. (9) MOD dispatch_ready (send_email mocked, live=True): an expired quote leads to not_applicable 'Quotation has expired', and a changed address leads to not_applicable 'Customer email address changed or missing'. Nothing was sent. FAILURES: (A) The 700-row CSV tender is NOT complete. With a valid CSV of 700 rows (82k characters, 726 rows including travel and repair), the job returned 692/700 machine service prices, while coverage claimed complete:true with 4/4 parts read. An earlier run on a CSV with unquoted commas returned 443/700. Rows are lost silently. (B) Import quantities are wrong. Every row prints 'Qty 2' with one serial. In the UI run, 240 lines came back as qty 1 and 160 as qty 2. In the API run, the total was 720 instead of 800. The model sometimes 'corrects' the quantity to the number of serials, and this differs between parts. (C) The Renewals screen shows a queued (awaiting_dispatch) renewal in red as 'Approved - email NOT delivered', with Copy link and Resend buttons. Resend then fails with 409. The reason: utils/cm_renewals.list_renewals leaves renewal_email_state out of its Mongo projection, so comms_status() never returns awaiting_dispatch or email_cancelled.

critical.issue: A 700-row CSV returned 692/700 machine_services, while coverage said complete:true and parts_read 4/4. There is no check that rows read match rows extracted, so prices are dropped silently. Before the CSV was fixed (unquoted commas), it returned 443/700.

Quantities are not copied exactly. Rows print 'PF-TR-900 ... Qty 2 Serial SNxxxxx'. In one run 240/400 lines came back as qty 1 (UI run); in the other the total was 720 instead of 800 (API run). The LLM changes the quantity to match the serial count, and results differ between parts. _PROMPT says to copy codes, models and serials exactly, but says nothing about quantities.

The projection leaves out renewal_email_state, so a queued renewal is reported as comms_status 'approved_not_delivered' ('Approved - email NOT delivered') instead of 'awaiting_dispatch'. Cancelled emails are also never shown as 'email_cancelled'.

minor.issue: The dedupe key contains a fresh _id(), so repeat clicks start new LLM jobs instead of returning the active one. This contradicts the _start_job docstring 'One active job per document'. Also, _start_job runs find_one and then insert_one, which is not atomic.
There is no 50 MB cap on the pricing path; only _create_import checks AFS_IMPORT_MAX_BYTES. The chunk protocol accepts up to 200 MB.
It claims ANY 'ready' follow-up across all orgs, which is fine for a cron but makes the function hard to test in isolation. This is a note only.

ui_bugs.issue: A queued renewal shows in red as 'Approved - email NOT delivered' and offers Resend, which returns 409 'Live renewal emails are switched off'. TONE has no colour for awaiting_dispatch or email_cancelled, and there is no UI for POST /renewals/{id}/cancel-email.

integration_issues.issue: The chunked upload uses localStorage 'token' (the main token). The CRM token returns 401 on /files/upload/chunks/* (verified). Today /crm redirects to the unified /login, so the main token is normally present. But if the main session has expired, or a stale main token belongs to another user, every Aftersales upload fails ('could not be processed' or 404). Before this change, the import used the CRM token.

issues: The customer select lists many unrelated '(suggested)' TEST_ orgs (TEST_DeleteMe_*, TEST Sicon Org *) when the customer is not identified; this is noisy test data in the operator org.
The PWA 'Install App' popup covers the centre of the results table during review.

Labels are separate as required ('reminder task created' / 'customer emailed' / 'customer contacted - outcome recorded'). But an email that is failed or not_applicable shows only 'reminder task created', so there is no hint that the customer was not emailed or why. Verified in code only, not in the UI.

action_items: Pricing extraction: compare the source row count (coverage.rows minus headers) with the extracted items for each part. Re-ask or split the parts that came back short, and set coverage.complete=false (with the missing rows listed) whenever items != rows, so the coordinator is warned. Make test_csv_700_rows_all_service_prices pass reliably (it got 692/700).

cm_quote_import._PROMPT: add 'copy the quantity EXACTLY as printed; never change it to match the number of serials'. Consider a regex fallback that reads 'Qty N' from the line text. Make test_import_from_file_reads_all_lines (qty == 800) pass.

utils/cm_renewals.list_renewals: add renewal_email_state:1 to the projection. In RenewalsInProgress, add a TONE colour for awaiting_dispatch and email_cancelled, hide Resend and Copy link while the email is queued, and add a 'Cancel customer email' (reason) action for users with renewals.approve.
AfsDocumentUploader: handle a missing or expired main token. Either accept the CRM token on the /files/upload/chunks endpoints, or show 'session expired - sign in again' on 401.
extract-pricing-jobs: give the pricing job a stable dedupe key (content_hash:pricing) and add the 50 MB cap.
critical_code_review_comments: crm_aftersales._start_job: the background asyncio task is lost if the backend restarts, and the job only fails after 30 minutes (on the next poll). The client waitForJob polls every 3 s with no client-side limit.

create_quote_import_from_file returns the earlier import for the same hash and doc_type even when the request has a different company_id. The UI then lets the coordinator change the customer, which is acceptable, but the API ignores company_id with no warning.
_create_import stores the source PDF (_put) before validating company_id, so a 404 for the customer leaves an orphaned object.
AftersalesApp.js is 3,718 lines and should be split (DocumentImportCard, the AutoQuote custom pricing and the wizard are separate concerns).

success_rate.backend: 88% (22 executed: 19 pass; fail = 700-row CSV completeness, renewals list state, plus the import quantity defect found in the same run)
success_rate.frontend: 85% (import, paging, search, filter, cancel/resume, already-imported, apply, price and save, and xlsx tender all work; Renewals queued-state display is wrong)

seed_data_creation: All temporary and deleted by id: TEST_lg_* contracts, companies, contacts, MOD groups, quotes, follow-ups (pytest teardown); TEST_lgui_* org, site, company, rate group, service config, 240 equipment, the import and quote AFS-2026-6BAF0 (crm2_afs_quotes); TEST_renui_* renewal; the files and jobs from my uploads. Seed and cleanup scripts: /tmp/afs/seed_ui.py and /tmp/afs/ren_ui.py (run with the cleanup argument).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_afs_large_doc_uploads_jan2026.py -v. The suite uses the public URL from frontend/.env and tokens minted with utils.auth.create_token plus /crm/auth/cross-login, so it does not hit the login rate limit. Use -k 'not Pricing and not ImportJob' to skip LLM calls. Fixtures: tests/fixtures/afs_large_docs.py (big_invoice_pdf at about 2.8 MB, tender_csv with 700 rows; avoid commas in descriptions). UI path: /login -> launch-contract_management -> crm-nav-build-quote; uploads use data-testid afs-aq-import-upload-file and afs-aq-pricing-upload-file (after afs-aq-type=custom). Click 'Later' on the PWA popup. Not tested: the tender wizard (afs-wiz-upload) in the UI, files of 13-50 MB, approving from the Action Centre UI (approved via the API instead), and the MOD chase chips in the UI.
rca of the issue: The 413 is reproduced: the legacy multipart upload is over the 2 MiB body_size_guard and gateway limits, and the fix is the chunked path. The new issues come from extraction fidelity (no item-vs-row reconciliation; the LLM is free to change quantities) and from a projection that leaves out renewal_email_state in list_renewals.
